《平复帖》笔意古拙、草隶相融，是研究早期文人墨迹的珍贵实物。: The 'Pingfu Tie' features an archaic brushwork blending cursive and clerical scripts, making it a valuable artifact for studying the ink works of early literati.

以连绵开张的一笔书拓展父法，与王羲之并称二王。: With a continuous and continuous stroke of calligraphy, he expanded on his father's style, and together with Wang Xizhi, was known as one of the Two Wangs.
《瘗鹤铭》宽博疏宕、篆意入楷，历来归属有争议，清代碑学尤重其气象。: The 'Inscription on the Crane Buried' is broad, sparse, and free-flowing, with seal script meaning integrated into regular script. Its attribution has long been debated, and Qing dynasty stele studies especially valued its grandeur.
以精熟的真草两体传承二王，《真草千字文》连接晋法与隋唐书学。: He passed on the two Wangs with a masterful blend of regular and cursive scripts, connecting Jin dynasty methods with Sui-Tang calligraphy.
以奔涌连绵的狂草开拓抒情书写，与怀素并称颠张醉素。: He pioneered and lyrical writing with surging, wild cursive script, and together with Huai Su, was known as 'Dianzhang, Zui Su.'
以宽博雄强的颜楷突破初唐清劲传统，行草又将情感推入笔墨深处。: With broad, powerful, and vigorous Yan Kai, he breaks through the early Tang's strong and refined tradition, while running and cursive script pushes emotion deep into the brush and ink.

以精熟今草写成《书谱》，使书法实践与系统笔法论述相互印证。: He wrote the 'Shupu' with refined modern cursive script, allowing calligraphic practice and systematic brush technique discussion to mutually verify each other.

以八面出锋、痛快刷写的行书化古为新，位列宋四家。: With his bold and bold writing style, his semi-cursive script transforms the ancient into the new, ranking among the four masters of the Song dynasty.

以厚实笔力与纵逸狂草打破拘谨，是吴门书派最具奔放气质的代表之一。: With his robust brushwork and free-spirited cursive to break restraint, he is one of the most unrestrained representatives of the Wu School of calligraphy.
以连绵轴线、强烈欹侧和浓淡涨墨重塑长篇行草，是明清之际的重要革新者。: Reconstructing long running and cursive scripts with continuous axes, strong leaning, and varying ink tones, he was an important innovator at the Ming and Qing transitions.
以隶法入篆、以碑意融帖，拓展清代篆隶书写的表现力。: By incorporating clerical script into seal script and blending the meaning of steles with model script, he expanded the expressive power of Qing dynasty seal and clerical script writing.
以碑骨融入行草，并整理推广标准草书，让草法走向易识易写。: Integrating stele bone into running and cursive script, and organizing and promoting standard cursive script, making cursive style easier to recognize and write.
以长线牵引、开张错落的行草书写诗词，形成鲜明的个人书写面貌。: He writes poetry with long, varied running and cursive scripts with long lines and open strokes, forming a distinctive personal style.
以骨力劲挺、结构严整的柳体，与颜真卿共同构成中晚唐楷书重镇。: With its powerful, upright, and tightly structured Liu style, he and Yan Zhenqing formed a major center of regular script in the mid to late Tang period.
以纤劲流动、提按分明的楷书，在初唐法度中保留行书的灵动。: With delicate, flowing, and distinct strokes in regular script, he retains the liveliness of running script within the early Tang dynasty standards.
以淡墨疏宕和虚灵章法倡导文人书风，深刻影响晚明及清初书坛。: He advocated the literati calligraphic style with light ink, loose and ethereal composition, profoundly influencing the calligraphy circles of the late Ming and early Qing dynasties.
以温润精严的小楷与清劲行书，成为吴门书派的重要代表。: With his gentle and rigorous small regular script and vigorous running script, he became an important representative of the Wu School of Calligraphy.
以盘旋绵密的连绵草势和生拙用笔，拓展清初书法的奇崛面貌。: With swirling, dense cursive styles and clumsy brushwork, he expands the extraordinary and prominent character of early Qing calligraphy.
以汉代书学与碑刻传统闻名，后世将飞白书的创制与他相联系。: He was renowned for his Han dynasty calligraphy and inscription tradition, and later generations associated the creation of Feibai script with him.
